# Equal listings exit 0.
exec sassequiv base.sass renamed.sass
stdout '^f: equal$'

# An equal that rests on both reading the same uninitialized register
# says so; it exits 0.
exec sassequiv undef.sass undef.sass
stdout '^f: equal \(assumes identical uninitialized R24, R25\)$'

# -json prints one object per function.
exec sassequiv -json base.sass renamed.sass
stdout '^\{"function":"f","verdict":"equal"\}$'
exec sassequiv -json undef.sass undef.sass
stdout '^\{"function":"f","verdict":"equal","assumes":\["R24","R25"\]\}$'
! exec sassequiv -json base.sass fmul.sass
stdout '^\{"function":"f","verdict":"different","reason":".*FMUL.*","before":"0x70","after":"0x70"\}$'

# A changed floating-point operation exits 1 and names both addresses.
! exec sassequiv base.sass fmul.sass
stdout '^f: different: .*before 0x70 FADD.*after 0x70 FMUL'

# An unmodeled instruction exits 3.
! exec sassequiv base.sass trap.sass
stdout '^f: unknown: after: unmodeled instruction BPT.TRAP at 0x10$'

# A function on one side only is a difference.
! exec sassequiv base.sass other.sass
stdout '^f: different: missing after$'
stdout '^g: different: missing before$'

! exec sassequiv base.sass
stderr 'usage: sassequiv \[-json\] before.sass after.sass'

! exec sassequiv base.sass missing.sass
stderr 'missing.sass: no such file'

-- base.sass --
	code for sm_90a
		Function : f
        /*0000*/                   ULDC.64 UR4, c[0x0][0x208] ;
        /*0010*/                   S2R R0, SR_TID.X ;
        /*0020*/                   LDC.64 R2, c[0x0][0x210] ;
        /*0030*/                   IMAD.WIDE.U32 R2, R0, 0x4, R2 ;
        /*0040*/                   LDG.E R6, desc[UR4][R2.64] ;
        /*0050*/                   LDG.E R7, desc[UR4][R2.64+0x4] ;
        /*0060*/                   NOP ;
        /*0070*/                   FADD R6, R6, R7 ;
        /*0080*/                   STG.E desc[UR4][R2.64], R6 ;
        /*0090*/                   EXIT ;

        /*0030*/                   IMAD.WIDE.U32 R8, R5, 0x4, R8 ;

        /*0050*/                   LDG.E R10, desc[UR4][R8.64] ;
        /*0060*/                   NOP ;

        /*0080*/                   STG.E desc[UR4][R8.64], R10 ;
        /*0090*/                   EXIT ;

	code for sm_90a
		Function : f
        /*0000*/                   ULDC.64 UR4, c[0x0][0x208] ;
        /*0010*/                   S2R R0, SR_TID.X ;
        /*0020*/                   LDC.64 R2, c[0x0][0x210] ;
        /*0030*/                   IMAD.WIDE.U32 R2, R0, 0x4, R2 ;
        /*0040*/                   LDG.E R6, desc[UR4][R2.64] ;
        /*0050*/                   LDG.E R7, desc[UR4][R2.64+0x4] ;
